text:
Cara M.: Quick check — thinking about serializing policy snapshots so runtimes can replay/eval locally with bounded staleness instead of hitting the control plane on every request. reduces p95 but introduces staleness. tradeoffs?

Ryan K.: +1 on local snapshots for hot paths. main concern is invalidation. TTL alone feels blunt. can we use generation ids + optional immediate invalidation for critical tenants?

Sahil P.: generation id + causal ordering sounds right. but for multi-tenant overrides (weights, emergency rollouts) we need a fast path to evict or mark superseded. otherwise customers see wrong routing for minutes.

Cara M.: rough proposal: snapshot blob = {gen, created_at, expiry, rules_blob}. runtime uses blob if (now - created_at) <= staleness_window OR request has low-latency flag. control plane exposes invalidate(gen) and a fallback fetch on miss.

Jenna L.: are we exposing callbacks from runtime to control plane? worried about surface area for Private deploys — network policies, auth, and KMS. need minimal API shape.

dev-bot: deploy preview: feature/policy-snapshots passed integration tests (3/3).

Ryan K.: API shape suggestion: GET /v1/snapshots/:id -> 200 + blob OR 404. POST /v1/snapshots/:id/invalidate -> 202. simple, auth via existing service tokens. add ?since=gen to ask for deltas later.

Sahil P.: delta encoding would help memory and network but complicates apply-order. for MVP keep compressed full blobs (gzip). set default staleness_window=2m, configurable per-tenant.

Cara M.: agree. telemetry: mark requests that used stale snapshot and emit age_of_snapshot histogram. also emit reason when fallback to control plane occurs. helps debugging.

Jenna L.: add note: private deployments may want encrypted snapshots at rest (KMS/HSM) and signed blobs to prevent drift. include that in RFC.

Ryan K.: migration plan idea: shadow mode -> canary (1%) -> 10% -> 50% -> global. measure routing divergence and latency delta at each stage.

Cara M.: sounds good. i'll draft an RFC with API shapes, telemetry, migration plan, and default config. will include a tiny example:

```
GET /v1/snapshots/tenant-42-gen-20240301
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{ "gen": "20240301", "created_at": "1710000000", "expiry": "1710001200", "rules_blob": "...base64 gzipped..." }
```
Cara M.: any objections to me owning the RFC and a small PoC? planning to run perf on dedicated pool next week.

Sahil P.: +1, please include failure modes: partial apply, corrupted blob, and large-blob OOM.

Jenna L.: +1, call out KMS requirement for Private.

Ryan K.: +1. also add a knob to require control-plane-eval for tenant with safety flag set.

Cara M.: thanks all — i'll post RFC link here in ~30m and tag infra/eng-runtime for review.
